reviews.author: Deborah Carrigan
reviews.text: Mecho tree service is absolutely wonderful. They were on time got the work done and cleaned up so well after themselves we could have never done a better job. The crew was great and very courteous. We were very pleased with the quote that we were given. We absolutely believe no one else could have done a better job. We will definitely be calling them again. Also we will make sure all of our neighbors, friends and family know about them.

reviews.author: Deidre
reviews.text: What symphony! This is the first time I've written a review for anything. The team showed up and took out an entire line of high trees without hitting anything else ie vehicles, trampoline, neighbors home.The had everything to grind trees and blowers to clean even dust debris. It was complete package and a very reasonable price. I will use them again and would tell anyone they are amazing.

reviews.author: Dei Robinson
reviews.text: Professional, prompt, and affordable service! Highly Recommended! Definitely would use them again for land clearing, brush removal, etc.

reviews.author: Blake Jurgensen
reviews.text: Highly recommend! Fast and efficient removal of a very large sycamore tree and stump. Cleaned up throughout the entire process. Prices better than anyone around! Very prompt and responsive. Will absolutely use again!

reviews.author: Anna Lowrance Tally
reviews.text: Quick response and great value! We have huge oak trees that needed a good trim. Now we are stocked with firewood and mulch as well!

reviews.author: Jon Holman
reviews.text: These guys are fantastic. In less than 3 hours they had this tree down, stump ground and finished. This is the 2nd time we have used them. Great to work with.

reviews.author: Samuel Conrad
reviews.text: Called Domecio a week ago, and we were quoted, booked, and paid out within seven days. Cut three trees (oaks) in excess of 100' height at crown. We opted to leave the lumber and mulch for a discount for firewood- we didn't have them grind the stumps. They came, they sawed, they conquered. We've 72 rose bushes, vegetable & herb garden on an acre within Statesville city limits. The largest oak was within 3' of the footprint of the house, and so rotten centrally that when taking the photos my foot sank into the stump. Domecio properly diagnosed the rot of the largest tree down to the beetle species (stag beetle) and they navigated between other flora and didn't disrupt a thing: one dogwood adjacent to the largest oak has a few stragglers of oak lodged in its boughs. Not a single landscaping brick was out of place. Finished within 7 hours. The wind speed was up to 25mph today. Exceptional pricing! Call Mecho: the best decision we've made since buying a house.

reviews.author: Nicole Rodden
reviews.text: I called them this morning for tree removal And they responded immediately and the job was completed by 2:30. Fast, professional, affordable. Loved them and would use them again and highly recommend!

reviews.author: Catherine
reviews.text: These guys were Super fast and efficient. They provided the best and most reasonable quote around. Would highly recommend to anyone!

reviews.author: Raymond Bowers
reviews.text: These guys have already done a couple of jobs for our family and have always left us completely satisfied with all of their work! They are the most reasonable tree service around no matter what you have them do! They are very polite and highly capable of any tree service needed, from having some trees trimmed, taken down, mulched and stump grinding! I would highly recommend you reach out to Mecho tree service for all your tree service needs!!

reviews.author: Ken Zimmerman
reviews.text: Amazing Service. Will use them again everytime. On time, professional, hard working, and great job cleaning up. Removed trees from my property and then went down the street and took one down for my dad.

reviews.author: ScottyB
reviews.text: I recently hired Mecho Tree Service for tree cutting services, and I couldn't be more impressed. Their team was friendly, professional, efficient, and knowledgeable. They arrived on time, assessed the trees carefully, and completed the job safely without causing any damage to my property. The crew worked quickly and left the area spotless afterward. I appreciate their attention to detail and dedication to safety. If you're looking for reliable and top-quality tree cutting services, I highly recommend Mecho Tree Service.

reviews.author: Kathy Wolfe
reviews.text: This crew has an incredible work ethic and they work as a team. I was amazed at how quickly they finished and how well they cleaned up. The cost was less than half of what others charged but believe me the work is quality. I won't be recommending anyone else. These guys are the best.

reviews.author: Alston Wiley
reviews.text: Unbeatable pricing and highly skilled crew. Cleanup was great, couldn’t even tell they’d been here. Really appreciate this group of guys.

reviews.author: Jackie Sigmon
reviews.text: Excellent service! Very professional and knowledgeable of their services. Removed the trees, crew did a great job cleaning up all the debris. Reasonably priced! 100% would recommend to anyone. I was also impressed that the job was done in a very timely manner.... I got a quote last week and the job was done today ~ 9/27/2022.

reviews.author: Nathan Estes
reviews.text: Excellent service, arrived to my home on time. Very professional and knowledgeable of their services. Removed the trees, great job cleaning up all the debris. Hard working crew. Very reasonable price. Will always call them for any future needs. Would recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: Patricia Antunez
reviews.text: I would highly recommend Mecho Tree Service!!! The team is very professional and have a great work ethic. They did an awesome job cutting down one of my front house trees and cleaned up nicely!

reviews.author: Wayne Bradshaw
reviews.text: After other bids came in just too high, in my opinion, I read Mecho's reviews and after their quote decided to go with them. I have to agree Demecio and his tree removal crew did a Fantastic job even though working in a confined space. The worked together, all performing their respective positions all the while helping each other. The are professional, very knowledgeable & work nonstop. They remove debri and clean up as they go leaving the area clean, if not cleaner, than when they arrived. Thank You Mecho Tree Service, Demecio, Son & Crew.

reviews.author: Rebecca Shipman
reviews.text: We were so pleased with this company! They beat everyone elses quote, responded quickly and on time and did a great job. I will absolutley use them again. The entire crew was so nice and they cleaned up every tiny thing when they were done. 5 stars and a smiley face!!!!!

reviews.author: Linda Higinbotham
reviews.text: Excellent service! They arrived when they said they would, worked quickly but were very safety conscious. Did a thorough job of cleaning up all the debris. They were a hard working team and a great value. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Kasey Tate
reviews.text: Mecho Tree Service is fantastic! I don’t typically write reviews, but Domecio and his crew deserve a 5-star review. They took down a huge dead tree in my backyard that was in danger of falling on our house. Other tree services either didn’t want the job, or wanted to charge outrageous prices to remove the tree. Domecio gave me a fair price, and did exactly what he said he would do. His crew was on time, very professional, and extremely efficient. I’ve already booked another job with Mecho to have some additional tree work done. Do yourself a favor, and call Mecho Tree Service!

reviews.author: M. Lee
reviews.text: They were prompt, and worked quickly to removed the fallen tree in our backyard. They cleaned up everything and did it all in an hour!! Amazing service!! We will definitely use them again in the future and highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Ryan Williams
reviews.text: These guys are awesome, responded quickly and removed a large tree that was very close to my house in 2 hours. They went above & beyond to ensure that we were satisfied. They removed a piece of sidewalk & spent extra time to place it back perfectly. There was no trace of leaves, mud, wood chips, or wood left in my yard when they were finished. I will only use Mecho from now on!

reviews.author: daisy 데이지
reviews.text: I found Mecho Tree Service on Google and I was not disappointed. They responded the first time I called, gave me a reasonable estimate for free, and came back to do the job within a day. I am definitely going to use this company in the future. I am so appreciative of the great service Mecho provides!

reviews.author: WayChar Richmond
reviews.text: Have never in my life written a review, but Mecho Tree deserves my praise. Took down 9 large trees in a narrow space between 2 houses. Never hit anything. The workers were all skilled with their saws, and equipment...and cleaned up thoroughly. I have found my tree Guy for the future! As an old time logger, who isn't easily impressed...I have to say...these men were impressive!! Hire Mecho...you will be glad you did!

reviews.author: Jonathan Travis
reviews.text: These guys did a great job. We had 10+ trees get knocked down due to a storm. They got the trees cut up and hauled off. They left the grounds much cleaner than expected. No complaints and will definitely use them again.

reviews.author: Jeff Nelson
reviews.text: Mecho tree service did an amazing job removing 7 trees from our yard. We are very happy with the work that was done and the clean up afterwards. I highly recommend them for all your tree removal needs!

reviews.author: Lori Nix
reviews.text: They took down two trees, stump removal removed all debris plus extra limbs I had piled up. I was very pleased with the quality of their work, how fast they are at responding and their pricing. I highly recommend them and I’ll use them again.

reviews.author: Katie French
reviews.text: Mr. Nuñez, and his crew, were very nice and worked very efficiently. They exceeded my expectations in every way. We received multiple quotes and they beat everyone by far, offering more service. Strongly recomend!

reviews.author: Nicolette Belardo
reviews.text: I highly recommend this company! Both jobs we had them do for us involved very tall trees on uneven grounds and steep hills, and they completed it without issue. The crew is very skilled at what they do; they leave the area clean and are careful not to damage anything in the surrounding area.

reviews.author: Tina Long
reviews.text: Mecho’s team were on time, well organized and had the right equipment to handle the huge job which included removing 8 huge trees, stumps ground and debris mulched. All in one day! Left the yard clean and minimal damage. Best contractor I have hired, ever!!! Tina Long

reviews.author: Erik D'Esterre
reviews.text: Amazing company with fantastic crew. Unbeatable prices for their services. Fast and thoughtful with their work. Will definitely hire again for future needs.

reviews.author: Evelyn Kokotkiewicz
reviews.text: Mecho Tree Service arrived on time, cut down my huge twice stricken by lightening leaning tree. They cut down the top hanging branches and limbs and then cut at the base of the trunk to bring the tree down. They cleaned as they worked clearing brush, branches and limbs to the edge of my property out of everyone's way. They were done in less that two hours. A wonderful job which is very much appreciated by me...no more worries about the tree falling down. Thanks Mecho!

reviews.author: Mardi Durham
reviews.text: They worked with my schedule to come by and give me an estimate. They arrived when they said they would and got right to work. They did a great job and cleaned up all of the debris when they were finished. I would definitely recommend them and would use them again.

reviews.author: Clay Pittman
reviews.text: They were great! Made quick work of the limbs we needed taken care of. They're able to climb instead of using a bucket truck so they can work in spaces others can't. Excellent value and excellent service.

reviews.author: Candi Cane
reviews.text: Owner and family are very nice. Sadly, I was charged for removing 2 trees and grinding two stumps. He only grinding one!! (Charged me the same amount) His worker broke my mail box. When I text the owner about these issues, he never texted back..

reviews.author: Timothy Smith
reviews.text: Mecho showed up when they said they would and were very professional. They did a great job and left my yard cleaner than when they arrived. I would recommend them to everyone without hesitation!

reviews.author: Whitney Wood
reviews.text: Highly recommend! Very reasonable prices and fast quick service. Trimmed my trees for half the price of other companies I called.

reviews.author: Jillian Kelley
reviews.text: The crew was great. All very hard workers. They were very careful with everything they did. They cleaned up as they went along. We would highly recommend them to do any of the services they perform!! They went above and beyond. Extremely Happy!!!!

reviews.author: Anja Kempermann
reviews.text: I worked with MEECHO Tree Service. Very happy. Great work. Quick and tidy. Very professional. Absolutely recommending these guys!

reviews.author: beverly futrell
reviews.text: Very responsive when called for quote. Arrived on time for the job! The entire crew was courteous and professional. Job was very reasonably priced. Couldn’t ask for better service!

reviews.author: Dee Cook
reviews.text: I was thrilled with the job that was done! Trimmed perfectly and cleaned up exceptionally well! Would highly recommend!! He was even here exactly when promised!

reviews.author: Marie Moore
reviews.text: Called Saturday, came Saturday said can do it Monday. They were here early and had the tree removed in less than 2 hrs. Highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Miguel Canizares
reviews.text: Demecio and his team are excellent. I’ve used their service two times now and they never disappoint. They are very professional and efficient. Don’t think it twice and hire Mecho.

reviews.author: scott wilkinson
reviews.text: Fantastic service! I will absolutely use them when i need more tree work done. Thank you to Demecio and his crew.

reviews.author: Gina DeLong
reviews.text: Super timely service - came out same day to give a quote and returned the next day to complete the job. Pricing was very reasonable.

reviews.author: Scott Austin
reviews.text: Meho tree service was great . Great price.ill be using them again in the spring. Thank you mecho tree service very much

reviews.author: Karl Bittinger
reviews.text: I would recommend them to everyone and will definitely use them in the future great prices, hard working, punctual, and clean up well when they are done.

reviews.author: Gloria Hayenga
reviews.text: I needed two big trees taken down. Mecho Tree Service did a wonderful job and would recommend them to anyone.

reviews.author: Wade Ikard
reviews.text: I have used this service numerous times and I've never been disappointed. And they haul and clean up all debris.

reviews.author: Kelli Houston
reviews.text: Excellent experience with this crew! Professional, efficient, very reasonable prices. Just can’t say enough about our experience. If you need tree service these are your guys!
